about: Each hub printed in its own ink on the shared bone paper, with two companion colors (Sam, 2026-11-05: richer than one ink): ink: light-mode text and accent; deep: dark-mode ground; warm: the highlight (a right answer's bar, today's ring, the drawings' spot color); cool: the quiet fill (missed-last-time bars, a drawing's shadow side). Keep every ink at 9:1 or more on the paper; warm and cool are fills, never text. 'later' holds the archived hubs' inks for the phase 2 token pass (vault/tasks/2026-11-05-site-redesign-taste.md); the build only touches 'hubs'.
